answer: To enroll, you will need your full name, your student ID number, and your year level. No document uploads are required for this demo system.
items: For irregular students: list of subjects you plan to take

answer: You can track your enrollment status by visiting /track/[your ENR number]. Your ENR number was displayed on the success page after you submitted your enrollment.
Your ENR number is a unique reference code assigned when you submit your enrollment. It follows the format ENR-YYYY-XXXX (e.g. ENR-2025-0042). Use it to track your enrollment status.

Irregular enrollment submissions are reviewed by staff. There is no fixed turnaround time in this demo system, but once a staff member logs in and confirms or rejects your enrollment, your tracking page will update immediately.
Regular students are auto-assigned subjects based on their year level and the BSIT curriculum. Irregular students may choose from the full available subject pool shown in the enrollment form.
